Tomato коротко звучит, когда что-то не п: Tomato plays a short sound when something goes wrong. The volume is the one set for alert sounds. There are no sounds when interface sound effects are turned off in System Settings, Sound. The signal at the end of a timer has its own switch, below
Tomato смотрит, нет ли новой версии, при: Tomato looks for a new version at launch, every three hours and after the Mac wakes up
Новая версия скачивается и ставится сама: A new version downloads and installs by itself when Tomato is idle. With this off, Tomato only offers to update
При варианте «Как в системе» Tomato берё: With “Same as System”, Tomato takes the first suitable language from the list in System Settings, Language & Region. A new language takes effect after a restart
Язык сменится после перезапуска: The language changes after a restart
При входе в систему Tomato запускается в: At login Tomato starts in the menu bar, to install updates on time
Запуск при входе выключен в Системных на: Opening at login is turned off in System Settings, under Login Items. It can be turned back on only there
Сервер обновлений просит подождать: The update server asks to wait
Установщика новой версии пока нет: No installer for the new version yet
Новая версия подписана иначе: The new version is signed differently
Проверьте интернет и попробуйте ещё раз: Check the internet connection and try again
Слишком много проверок подряд. Попробуйт: Too many checks in a row. Try again in an hour
Новая версия вышла, но её установщик ещё: A new version is out, but its installer isn’t posted yet. Try again later
Скачивание не закончилось. Попробуйте ещ: The download didn’t finish. Try again or get the installer from the download page
Скачанный установщик повреждён или в нём: The downloaded installer is damaged or has no new version of Tomato in it. Try again
Новая версия подписана не так, как устан: The new version is signed differently from the installed one and won’t install by itself. Get the installer from the download page and drag Tomato to the Applications folder
Не получилось поставить новую версию. От: Couldn’t install the new version. Open the installer and drag Tomato to the Applications folder
Новая версия встанет, когда Tomato освоб: The new version goes in when Tomato is idle or quits
Эта сборка сделана из исходного кода и с: This build is made from the source code and doesn’t update itself
Автоматическая проверка выключена. Прове: Automatic checks are off. Check with this button or with “Check for Updates…” in the menu of the menu bar icon
Tomato сам проверяет, вышла ли новая вер: Tomato checks for a new version by itself and installs it when it is idle
Tomato checks for a new version by itself and offers to install it
Минуты через запятую, от 1 до 60. Они по: Minutes separated by commas, from 1 to 60. They appear in the “…” menu under the ruler
Показывать время в строке меню: Show the time in the menu bar
Пока идёт таймер, рядом с помидором стои: While a timer runs, the time stands beside the tomato. Without it only the tomato stays, and its upper half turns towards zero along with the time
В строке меню время идёт с секундами: 24: The menu bar counts down with seconds: 24:13. Without seconds it shows minutes: 25 min
Звук в конце, на обычной громкости: Sound at the end, at normal volume
Когда время вышло, Tomato звонит три раз: When time is up, Tomato rings three times, like an alarm. It plays at the Mac's normal volume, and the Sound effects switch does not affect it
Когда время вышло, macOS показывает увед: macOS shows a notification from Tomato when time is up. The permission is asked at the first start
Уведомления Tomato выключены в Системных: Tomato notifications are turned off in System Settings, Notifications. The sound and the flashing icon stay
